items.title: #Magic center Goga Bitadze got in foul trouble Monday but still recorded 11 points, 5 rebounds, 2 steals and 2 blocks in 27 mins. to help Georgia win, 98-90, at Portugal.
items.author: Jason Beede
items.body_excerpt:
#Magic center Goga Bitadze got in foul trouble Monday but still recorded 11 points, 5 rebounds, 2 steals and 2 blocks in 27 mins. to help Georgia win, 98-90, at Portugal.

Georgia went 2-0 in the fourth qualifying window in hopes of reaching the FIBA World Cup 2027 in Qatar.

items.title: #Magic center Goga Bitadze notched 23 points (3 for 7 from 3-point range!) with 8 REB, 2 AST and 2 BLK in 30 minutes to help Georgia take down Montenegro 101-74 Friday in a FIBA World Cup Qualifier.
items.author: Jason Beede
items.body_excerpt:
#Magic center Goga Bitadze notched 23 points (3 for 7 from 3-point range!) with 8 REB, 2 AST and 2 BLK in 30 minutes to help Georgia take down Montenegro 101-74 Friday in a FIBA World Cup Qualifier.

Georgia’s next qualifier is Monday against Portugal.

items.title: Good all-around games from Sandro Mamukelashvili and Goga Bitadze in Georgia's blowout win over Montenegro.
items.author: KeithSmithNBA
items.body_excerpt:
Good all-around games from Sandro Mamukelashvili and Goga Bitadze in Georgia's blowout win over Montenegro.

Mamukelashvili: 17/7/6, 2 steals
Bitadze: 23 points, 8 rebounds, 1 steal, 2 blocks

Former NBAer Tornike Shengelia led the way with 24 points for Georgia.
